name: Email
description: Give your Bots an inbox over IMAP and SMTP: search threads, read conversations and attachments, reply through review cards, and run routines when mail arrives.

setup.title: Connect a mailbox
setup.description: Use any mailbox that supports IMAP and SMTP: a new Gmail or iCloud account, a Google Workspace user on your domain, Fastmail, Purelymail, Yahoo, Zoho, or your own mail server. A dedicated mailbox for the Bot is safest.
steps: Create or choose the mailbox the Bot will use. A separate account keeps your personal mail out of the Bot's reach.

Turn on 2-Step Verification for that account, then create an app password (Google: myaccount.google.com/apppasswords; iCloud: account.apple.com, Sign-In and Security, App-Specific Passwords; Yahoo and Fastmail have the same option).
Enter the full email address and the app password. Leave the servers on auto; OpenTeam finds them from the address. For your own server or Proton Mail Bridge, enter the IMAP and SMTP addresses.
Choose Connect. OpenTeam signs in to check the password, then the account shows Connected.

Ask a Bot to set up a routine that watches this mailbox, for example: reply to mail from my address. Replies wait on a draft card for you to send. To let a Bot email someone without asking, choose Always allow in the card's approval menu.

fields.label: Email address
fields.helpText: The mailbox the Bot reads and sends from.

fields.label: App password
fields.helpText: Gmail, Google Workspace, iCloud and Yahoo need an app password, not the normal sign-in password. Outlook.com and Microsoft 365 do not allow app passwords for mail and cannot be used.

fields.label: Sign-in username
fields.helpText: auto signs in with the email address. iCloud custom-domain addresses sign in with the iCloud username (the part before @icloud.com).

fields.label: IMAP server
fields.helpText: auto detects it from the address. Otherwise host or host:port (993 uses TLS), or imap://host:port for a local bridge.

fields.label: SMTP server
fields.helpText: auto detects it from the address. Otherwise host or host:port (465 uses TLS, 587 STARTTLS), or smtp://host:port for a local bridge.

skills.name: email-mailbox
skills.description: When reading, answering, sending, or searching mail in a connected Email plugin inbox, or setting up a routine that watches one.

installationSteps: Install this plugin from the registry.
Open account settings, enter the mailbox address and app password, and choose Connect. Add more accounts for more mailboxes.
Confirm the account is Connected. Every Bot can use it; mail wakes a Bot only through a routine with an email trigger.
